sn7.6:1.1: Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || || Atha kho jaṭā-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi || sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno jaṭā-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn7.6:2.1: Antojaṭā bahijaṭā || jaṭāya jaṭitā pajā || taṃ taṃ Gotama pucchāmi || ko imaṃ vijaṭaye jaṭan ti || ||
sn7.6:3.1: Sīle patiṭṭhāya naro sapañño || cittaṃ paññañca bhāvayaṃ || ātāpī nipako bhikkhu || so imam vijaṭaye jaṭaṃ || ||
sn7.6:4.1: Yesaṃ rāgo ca doso ca || avijjā ca virājitā || khīṇāsavā arahanto || tesaṃ vijaṭitā jaṭā || ||
sn7.6:5.1: Yattha nāmañca rūpañca || asesam uparujjhati || paṭighaṃ rūpasaññā ca || ettha sā chijjate jaṭā ti || ||
sn7.6:6.1: Evaṃ vutte jaṭā-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama || pa || Aññataro ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosīti || ||
